title: Learning Roadmap for System Development Project (SDP)
description: A roadmap for completing a software development project as part of a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program.

subtopics: Identifying target audience and user needs
Developing a project timeline and budget
Analyzing user stories and use cases
Developing UML diagrams (Use-case, Activity, Class, Sequence, Deployment)
Designing user interface (UI) and user experience (UX)
Following coding standards and best practices
Writing a comprehensive project report (at least 50 pages)
Including design specifications, data dictionary, source code, screenshots
Creating user manuals and other relevant documentation
Preparing a presentation to showcase the project
Preparing for questions on project concepts, design, implementation, and testing
Demonstrating understanding of the project and its components
